# Stones River Therapy and Wellness PLLC

> Couples therapy and trauma therapy (including EMDR) for adults 18 and up, with Jamie Hallor, MSW, LCSW, a Licensed Clinical Social Worker in Tennessee (#10780). In person in Murfreesboro, TN (Rutherford County) on Tuesdays, and by video on Wednesdays for anyone physically in Tennessee. Private pay with posted fees; superbills available. Free 15-minute consult.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://stonesrivertherapy.com/): who the practice helps and how to start
- [Couples therapy](https://stonesrivertherapy.com/couples): Gottman Method couples therapy (Level 1 trained)
- [Rebuilding trust after an affair](https://stonesrivertherapy.com/affair-recovery): affair recovery for couples
- [Trauma therapy and EMDR](https://stonesrivertherapy.com/trauma-emdr): EMDR in person; talk therapy also by video
- [Intensives](https://stonesrivertherapy.com/intensives): 3-hour couples and EMDR intensives, in person
- [How I work](https://stonesrivertherapy.com/how-i-work): Gottman Method, EMDR, CBT, DBT and other approaches in plain words
- [About Jamie](https://stonesrivertherapy.com/about): training, license and background
- [Fees and insurance](https://stonesrivertherapy.com/fees): session fees, superbills, cancellation policy
- [Telehealth](https://stonesrivertherapy.com/telehealth): video therapy anywhere in Tennessee
- [What to expect](https://stonesrivertherapy.com/what-to-expect): consult, first session, paperwork
- [FAQ](https://stonesrivertherapy.com/faq)
- [Book a free consult](https://stonesrivertherapy.com/book): request an appointment online, or call or text (615) 200-0063

## Not offered
- Services for children or teens (adults 18+ only)
- Crisis services. In a crisis, call or text 988 or call 911.
